agent.why: Cheap, fast tool-caller with image input; the orchestrator's default brain. Escalates to gpt-6-astra for hard creative plans.

planning.why: Tool calling and judgement for shot selection and the refine chat when the cheap agent escalates.

tagging.why: Temporal video understanding of contact sheets and short slices; cheapest model that accepts video, image and audio in one call.

review.why: Independent visual and creative review of sampled frames and the rendered draft.

music.why: Background beds generated once into the local bank, reused with cached beat grids. Generated music is not automatically delivery-cleared (docs/MUSIC-LICENCES.md).

tts.pricing: per character unless the endpoint reports audio tokens
tts.why: Studio voice when a key is configured. Speech models are served by the dedicated endpoint and are not listed in /models; probe before use. Kokoro remains the offline default.

transcription.why: Word-level timings for remix and caption alignment. Optional; local silence detection still works without it.

agent.why: Interactive: the user is waiting on a plan or an edit.

planning.why: Interactive: the user is waiting on a plan or a chat reply. Throughput beats a few tenths of a cent.

tagging.why: Video-capable models are scarce; availability beats a marginal price difference.

review.why: Runs unattended in the background; let OpenRouter pick the healthy provider.

music.why: Metered per track, not per token.

tts.why: Only used when a voiceover must be generated.

caching.policy: System instructions, JSON schema/tool registry and style guide go first and never change between calls in a stage; variable content (contact sheet, shot table, user request) goes last. Anthropic models get an explicit ephemeral cache_control breakpoint; Gemini and OpenAI cache long stable prefixes implicitly.
caching.measure: Record usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens and usage.cache_discount on every call; net cost = estimate - cache_discount.

upscaling.note: Opt-in, per file, priced before it runs. Never part of a batch.
